behavior: Eight old SQL bodies guard every fresh source, preview, review bridge, v1/v2 approval, v1/v2 claim and provider-operation intent after exact replay. Main, every child, confirmation and retries are covered through the unchanged public v2 wrapper.

Private overloads require the existing READ COMMITTED company/year guard and resolve exact immutable source/observation identity, scope, hash and observation time. The target must have no successor and no withdrawal.

Frozen-codec structural binding pairs every case event with a unique indexed evidence row and its matching governed receipt. Removing both reference arrays or disguising a capital receipt as a dividend fails. This does not replace economic validation or authoritative Governance enumeration.

Existing committed replay, historical query and intent-outcome recording remain unchanged. New private functions stay ungranted; original OID, owner, ACL, security configuration and volatility are checked during finite anchored patching.
Rollback refuses retained withdrawals atomically. Empty rollback keeps the inert guards; no receipt is erased and no old unguarded writer is restored.

review.result: No remaining material findings after structural omission fix. Root independently inspected admission/replay placement and final added driver-error regression.
review.findingFixed: An earlier parser checked only equality of receipt/evidence references; deleting both arrays could omit a retained capital reference. Final parser also binds case event structure.
review.finalAdditionalCase: Root reviewed the added actual-SQL stale-error translation case; final collection is102, not executed.

nativeParser.scope: Exact source-reference parser overloads and exact current-observation predicate on native PostgreSQL 17.11. The held-lock/admission assertion is a stub. No full migration, Supabase, RLS, ACL, real admission, old entry-point patch or race proof.

limits: 102 real database cases were collected only. Complete migration, actual restricted-role ACL/RLS, both lock orders, legacy direct SQL, replay/outcome behavior and rollback still require CI execution.

Native PostgreSQL ran the exact parser overloads and active predicate against minimal owned tables, with the held-lock/admission assertion stubbed. Four valid,20 malformed and4 stale cases passed; this is not a substitute for full database proof.
Current-readiness wrappers and the old observation-list representation are separate unresolved work. Shared context internals remain unchanged to preserve existing approval replay.
Canonical Governance final SQL currentness/evidence repair, retained-generation tracking and Archive-owner completion/Company Access receipt eligibility remain pending technical dependencies.
Withdrawal execution is still ungranted; no runtime activation or future-facade change. All A1-A7, linked immutable complete gates and external launch clearances remain pending.
